text: EX-99.1 2 qdel9272026ex991earningsre.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 QuidelOrtho Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results ― Growth in Labs and Immunohematology Outside of China Highlights Underlying Business Strength ― ― New Cost Transformation and Enterprise Restructuring Program Expected to Deliver Over $80 Million in Annual Savings in 2027 ― ― Updated Full-Year 2026 Financial Guidance Narrowing Prior Ranges ― November 3, 2026 SAN DIEGO, CA November 3, 2026 — QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL) (the “Company” or “QuidelOrtho”), a leading global provider of diagnostic solutions, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 27, 2026. Key Third Quarter 2026 Results: (all comparisons are to the prior year period) • Total revenue was $619 m illion, a decrease of 12% both as reported and in constant currency. Excluding respiratory, China, and the U.S. Donor Screening business, total revenue grew 2% as reported and 3% in constant currency, reflecting the underlying strength of the business. ◦ Labs revenue of $353 million declined 6% both as reported and in constant currency, primarily due to lower sales in China related to recently announced changes to In Vitro Diagnostics pricing . Outside China, Labs revenue grew 3% as reported and 4% in constant currency, driven by continued strength across the business. ◦ Immunohematology revenue of $142 million was flat as reported and increased 1% in constant currency. Outside China, Immunohematology revenue g rew 2% as reported and 3% i n constant currency. ◦ Point of Care revenue of $120 million declined 27% both as reported and in constant currency due to a softer respiratory season. • GAAP net loss was $54 million; GAAP operating loss was $8 million; adjusted EBITDA was $148 million. • GAAP net loss margin was 8.7%; GAAP operating loss margin was 1.2%; adjusted EBITDA margin wa s 23.9% . • GAAP diluted loss per share was $0.78; adjusted diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) was $0.31. • Operating cash flow was $20 million; free cash flow was $0.3 million. “The underlying performance of our Labs and Immunohematology businesses remained solid in the third quarter, supported by the strength and durability of our customer relationships and our large global installed base,” said Brian J. Blaser, President and Chief Executive Officer of QuidelOrtho. “While China and a softer respiratory season continue to pressure our results, we are taking decisive action to strengthen the Company through a new cost transformation and enterprise restructuring program. This program is designed to improve profitability and cash flow while evolving our operating model around the distinct needs of our customers and markets. We believe these actions will help mitigate near-term headwinds and position the Company for sustainable long-term growth.” Cost Transformation and Restructuring Program The Company has initiated a new cost transformation and enterprise restructuring program designed to further improve its cost structure and evolve its operating model around two focused businesses, Core Diagnostics and Point of Care Diagnostics. The new operating model is designed to increase customer focus, create clearer accountability for business performance, and better align technology development and investment priorities with the distinct needs of each business. The Company expects the program to deliver over $80 million in annual savings in 2027 and to record approximately $30 to $35 million in one-time restructuring charges in the fourth quarter of 2026. Conference Call Information QuidelOrtho will hold a conference call and webcast today beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET to discuss its financial results. Interested parties can access the live webcast on the “Investor Relations” page of the Company’s website at https://ir.quidelortho.com/events-and-presentations . A replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the event on the Company’s website. QuidelOrtho is dedicated to advancing diagnostics to power a healthier future. For more information, please visit quidelortho.com and follow QuidelOrtho on LinkedIn, Facebook and X. About QuidelOrtho Corporation With expertise spanning clinical chemistry, immunoassay, immunohematology and molecular testing, QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL) is a leading global provider of diagnostic solutions, dedicated to advancing fast, accurate and reliable results that help improve patient outcomes – from the point of care to hospital, lab to clinic. Building on a legacy of innovation, QuidelOrtho works with healthcare providers to advance diagnostics that connect insights with solutions, defining a clearer path for informed decisions and better care. These non-GAAP financial measures should be considered supplemental to, and not a substitute for, financial information prepared in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”). These non-GAAP financial measures eliminate impacts of certain non-cash, unusual or other items that the Company does not consider indicative of its ongoing operating performance, and the Company generally uses these non-GAAP financial measures to facilitate management’s financial and operational decision-making, including evaluation of the Company’s historical operating results and comparison to competitors’ operating results. The Company’s definitions of these non-GAAP measures may differ from similarly titled measures used by others. These non-GAAP financial measures reflect an additional way of viewing aspects of the Company’s operations that, when viewed with GAAP results and the reconciliations to corresponding GAAP financial measures, may provide a more complete understanding of factors and trends affecting the Company’s business. Because non-GAAP financial measures exclude the effect of items that will increase or decrease the Company’s reported results of operations, management strongly encourages investors to review the Company’s consolidated financial statements and reports filed with the Commission in their entirety. Reconciliations of the historical non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures are included in the tables accompanying this press release.
